revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The phrase 'trillion-yen-scale global system' emphasizes financial scale, which may trigger skepticism among academic researchers.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Replaced 'trillion-yen-scale global system' with 'a global system used by millions of people, generating cryptographic challenges at a scale that no academic testbed can replicate' in both the key points and speaker notes.

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The claim that these are 'publication-worthy challenges' is asserted but not proven.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Added concrete proof point to speaker notes: 'Groth16, one of the most widely-used ZK-SNARK constructions, was published at EUROCRYPT—that's the kind of research that emerges from this ecosystem.'

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The '20+ vulnerabilities' stat lacks specificity about what kind of vulnerabilities.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Added characterization to speaker notes: 'These include critical consensus-layer bugs that could have affected network security.'

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The founder's personal transformation is mentioned in passing but never dramatized.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Added first-person moment to speaker notes: 'I know this isolation personally. During my master's, I had almost no contact with researchers outside my institution. That experience is why I built this bridge. That's why I left the traditional path.'

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: DEPCON Hakodate is described but the slide doesn't convey what actually happens there.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Added concrete detail to speaker notes: 'It's an unconference-style format where anyone can propose a topic and lead a discussion—no formal hierarchy, just researchers talking about problems they care about.'

additional_enhancement.description: Added concrete next step to call to action per executive review observation about the soft CTA.
additional_enhancement.enhancement_applied: Added to speaker notes: 'After this talk, I'll share a link to the PSE RFP list. Pick one problem that interests you. That's all it takes to start.'

Additionally, slide 10 incorporates the suggested concrete next step from the executive review's additional observations.
